doc.install: JcxBuild::installExamples() upserts one jcx_item row per item by item_ex_code = x, with item_example = 1 and item_status = 0. Examples never go into live.php or c.json.
doc.columns: x -> item_ex_code; name -> item_name; unit -> item_unit; kind -> item_kind; place -> item_place; dev -> item_dev; pages -> item_pages; size.w/h/wm/hm -> item_w/h/wm/hm; media -> item_media (JSON); texts.url/alt/title/text/brand/cta -> item_url/alt/title/text/brand/cta; code.code/code_m/mode -> item_code/item_code_m/item_code_mode; opts -> item_opts (JSON); note -> item_note. Store text fields with the same input filter as an admin save (CONTRACT-FIELDS: decode once, escape once).
doc.pv: pv = the preview place(s) of ADS-BRIEF 9.3 verbatim (the brackets). place = the single item_place stored (first place of pv that table 1.1 allows for the unit).
doc.tokens: Replace before storing: {b} = install directory (MAC_PATH, ends with /); {abs} = absolute base URL (scheme + host + MAC_PATH); {home} = absolute home page URL; {newest_vod_id} = vod_id of the newest video (integer, 0 when none). In the VAST template, replacements go inside CDATA.
doc.vast: Write vast.xml (tokens replaced) to vast.file at install time; when static/jcx/x/ is not writable use vast.fallback and put that URL into X48 media.vast.
doc.paths: Every media path is relative to the install directory (prefix MAC_PATH when printing). Names are 8 hex of sha1 (first window without "ad").
doc.new_keys: Keys this manifest adds to the 3.3 lists: media.webm (second source), media.pod (X59 two-ad list), media.cards for the X23 rails (start, end), opts.roll (pre | reward; UD4: no mid / post, every video plays in the provider's iframe player), opts.layout (grid | carousel | collection), opts.every / opts.max on U16 in-feed (X50).
doc.remote: Test videos by URL (video / vast items accept http(s) media): X41, X49 and X59 ad 1 = https://vjs.zencdn.net/v/oceans.mp4 (46.6 s); X44, X60 and X59 ad 2 = https://www.w3schools.com/html/mov_bbb.mp4 (10 s); X43 and X52 = https://content.jwplatform.com/manifests/yp34SRmf.m3u8 (HLS, 25.5 s, 180p-1080p); the X48 VAST MediaFiles = the two MP4s. They load from those hosts only in the admin preview (examples never reach visitors); they are not in the files table and do not count toward the media budget.
